set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Add make_within_subject_contrast_images() for repeated-measures factorial designs. It should create one planned contrast image per subject, e.g. task:model interaction, before group-level scale-space analysis. Keep factorial meaning outside the scanner. Tests: tiny 2x2 cell images match hand-computed contrasts and missing cells fail clearly.
set.title: Scale-space: repeated-measures contrast image helper
